help: promote what corpus-yoga browser capture staged into shared storage: each unit related to the held one of its address (new, identical, extends, ahead, diverged) and, where a family validates it, judged by the verdict corpus-yoga pipeline rehearse cached; copied over the held one where nothing held would be lost, the rest named; the stage is never written

args.name: --provider
args.help: every unit ONE provider's browser capture staged, or with --id one of them

args.name: --id
args.help: one unit of the provider --provider names: a prefix of a component of its address under the provider (a conversation id, a session's uuid, a project's memory) matching exactly one; requires --provider

args.name: --all
args.help: every unit the browser capture staged, every provider

args.name: --rehearsal
args.help: the rehearsal whose verdicts are read, by the stamp of its log (default: the newest under tmp/stage/rehearsal); a record's digests refuse a judgement of bytes since recaptured
